data.name: FirstRun_Subtitle
data.value: KXC-ConnectionManager reads your KeePassXC database without changing it.

data.name: FirstRun_NoDbSubtitle
data.value: You create it in KeePassXC, in three steps.

data.name: FirstRun_Step1
data.value: Open KeePassXC and create a new database (KDBX 4 format recommended).

data.name: FirstRun_Step2
data.value: Set a password and a key file, and save the file in a synced folder.

data.name: FirstRun_Step3
data.value: Add entries with the tags rdp, ssh or sftp, then come back here.

data.name: Unlock_Hint
data.value: Press Enter to unlock. The password is never saved.

data.name: Unlock_PasswordRequired
data.value: Enter the password, or choose a key file.

data.name: Main_SearchPlaceholder
data.value: Search for a host or a customer

data.name: Main_NoResultsFor
data.value: No results for «{0}». Press Esc to clear the search.

data.name: Main_NoEntries
data.value: No entries with the tags rdp, ssh or sftp. Add them to your entries in KeePassXC and they will show up here.

data.name: Main_Shortcuts
data.value: ↑ ↓ move · Enter connect · Ctrl+Enter SFTP · Ctrl+D favorite · Esc clear

data.name: Detail_SshKey
data.value: SSH key from the KeePassXC agent

data.name: Detail_PasswordNote
data.value: The password stays in KeePassXC: it is never shown or copied.

data.name: Warning_MissingHost
data.value: Host missing: add the Host field or the URL to this entry in KeePassXC.

data.name: Warning_InvalidData
data.value: Invalid host, port, user or domain: fix them in KeePassXC.

data.name: Warning_AmbiguousPath
data.value: Another entry, possibly expired, has the same name in the same folder: rename one of them in KeePassXC.

data.name: Status_LocksInUnderAMinute
data.value: locks in less than a minute

data.name: Status_ConnectNotAvailable
data.value: {0} to {1}: not available on this system yet, coming in the next steps.

data.name: HostKey_Message
data.value: This computer does not know the key of {0} yet. Before trusting it, check that the fingerprint below is the server's.

data.name: HostKey_HowToCheck
data.value: On the server you can see it with «ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub», or ask whoever manages it. If it does not match, cancel.

data.name: Error_ClientNotFound
data.value: {0} client not found. Install it or choose another client in Settings.

data.name: Error_ProtocolNotSupported
data.value: {0} is not available on this system yet.

data.name: Error_LaunchFailed
data.value: The {0} client did not start. Try again; if it happens again, check that it is installed correctly.

data.name: Error_CliNotFound
data.value: keepassxc-cli not found. Install KeePassXC 2.7.0 or later, or set the keepassxc-cli path in Settings.

data.name: Error_CliVersionTooOld
data.value: KeePassXC is too old. Install KeePassXC 2.7.0 or later.

data.name: Error_DatabaseNotFound
data.value: The database file is no longer at this path. Choose it again with «Change database».

data.name: Error_KeyFileNotFound
data.value: Key file not found. Plug in the USB drive or choose the key file again.

data.name: Error_UnsupportedFormat
data.value: This file is not a KeePassXC database (KDBX 3.1 or 4). Choose the right .kdbx file.

data.name: Error_InvalidCredentials
data.value: Wrong password or key file. Try again.

data.name: Error_EntryNotFound
data.value: Entry not found in the database. The database may have changed: try again after it reloads.

data.name: Error_Locked
data.value: The database is locked. Unlock it to continue.

data.name: Error_Timeout
data.value: keepassxc-cli did not answer in time. Try again; if it happens again, restart the app.

data.name: Error_ReadFailed
data.value: Cannot read the database. Try again; if the file is syncing, wait a few seconds.

data.name: Settings_KeyFileNote
data.value: The key file is used from the next unlock.

data.name: Settings_CliUnsafe
data.value: This executable is in a folder other users can change: for safety it is not used. Choose the one installed with KeePassXC.

data.name: Settings_AutoLockNote
data.value: It also locks when the screen is locked and on suspend.

data.name: Settings_LanguageNote
data.value: The language applies from the next start.

data.name: Settings_DatabaseChanged
data.value: Database changed: unlock it to continue.

data.name: Status_ReloadRetrying
data.value: the file is syncing, trying again shortly…

data.name: Status_CredentialsChanged
data.value: The database password or key file changed: unlock it again.

data.name: Warning_UnsafeSshUser
data.value: The user name contains characters not allowed for SSH and SFTP (spaces, quotes, symbols): fix it in KeePassXC.
